consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Sofia; Australian Embassy, Athens
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Sofia, headed by an Honorary Consul. The consulate provides limited consular services but can’t issue emergency passports or perform notarial acts. Get in contact before you visit.
